messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool inference-high reporting SATURATION and autoscaler failures. Autoscaler error: "Scale operation failed: quota_exceeded". Queue depth increasing (4000 -> 18k in 20m). Multiple 429s showing up across tiers.

alice (oncall): ack, I'm on it. paging @ben and @carla. started a short runbook: check scale logs, rate-limiter, and any recent config changes.

ben: pulling logs now. scale request responses:
```
2024-06-10T14:02:12Z ERROR scale: request rejected: pool_quota_exceeded pool=inference-high requested=4 available=0
2024-06-10T14:03:01Z WARN  rate: token bucket depleted tenant=free
```
Seeing a bunch of 429s originating from the global rate limiter, not model runtime yet. Autoscaler attempted to add 6 nodes but backlog kept growing.

carla: from metrics: token_bucket.capacity=5000, refill_rate=1000/s, avg_tokens_per_request=1200 (long-chat requests). That math means token depletion with bursts. Also observed tail queues holding long sequences => high token cost per req.

alice (oncall): got it. quick mitigations proposal:
1) increase token_bucket.capacity -> 20000 and refill_rate -> 4000/s for 30m
2) apply emergency per-tenant throttles: limit free-tier to 10r/s and priority-tier to 100r/s
3) enable fallback to smaller model-variants for non-SLA customers to drop cost per request
4) pause non-critical batch jobs hitting inference-high

ben: applying token-bucket override now (temp). command:
```
./infra config set rate_limiter.token_bucket.capacity 20000 
./infra config set rate_limiter.token_bucket.refill_rate 4000
./infra config apply --target rate-limiter --env prod --reason "emergency GPU saturation"
```

infra-bot: apply started (run id: ab4f3). Note: scale pool requests still failing due to cloud quotas. Contacting cloud-quotas team.

deploy-bot: rate-limiter config updated and rolled out to 4 clusters (inference-high, inference-large, inference-medium, inference-fallback).

carla: metrics update - queue depth dropping from 18k -> 7k in 8m, 429 rate down from 9% -> 1.8%. Latency improved for short requests but long-chat tail still high. Fallback rules routed ~22% of traffic to smaller models.

alice (oncall): good. customer impact: preliminary: ~12% of external requests (mostly free-tier) saw 429s or timeouts during the peak 14:00-14:25 UTC. No premium SLA customers reported errors, we routed them to reserved capacity. Logging ticket IDs for notable customers: cust-eta-1 (retried), cust-pay-09 (rate-limited but got fallback), cust-research-3 (experienced higher latencies).

ben: cloud quotas team replied: quota increase in progress but will take ~2h for full provisioning. For now we can't rely solely on autoscaler.

alice (oncall): additional mitigation: enable gradual token cost smoothing (max tokens per request cap) to prevent single requests from starving the bucket. ben will deploy.

ben: deployed request token cap of 5000 tokens per request. Also paused low-priority batch queue `inference-batch-low`.

deploy-bot: config changes applied. Observability: 429 rate now ~0.6%, overall Q depth ~2200.

carla: starting incident impact note for status page. Draft: "We are investigating an interruption to inference API performance caused by GPU capacity exhaustion and a rate-limiter configuration that caused excessive 429s under burst traffic. Mitigations are in place; some customers may have seen errors between 14:00-14:25 UTC."

alice (oncall): ping @support to triage high-touch customers and notify enterprise accounts. @sre-team please prepare postmortem focused on autoscaler quotas and token-bucket defaults.

sre-team: acknowledged. will own follow-up. assigning action items: (1) set safer default token_bucket to capacity=10000/refill=2000, (2) add autoscaler fallback to model-variant routing, (3) automate emergency increase script for token-bucket and per-tenant limits.

alice (oncall): handing off to night oncall @dave. Summary for handoff:
- root cause: autoscaler unable to add instances due to cloud quota, global rate limiter token_bucket too small for bursty long requests -> 429 amplification
- actions taken: increased token_bucket, capped tokens per-request, routed non-SLA traffic to smaller models, paused low-priority batch jobs, contacted cloud quota team
- current state: queue decreasing, 429s minimal, quota increase pending (~2h)
- what to watch: queue depth, 429 rate, CPU/GPU utilization, any errors from model-fallback

dave (oncall-2): ack. I'll monitor through the night and escalate if queue grows >5k or 429s >2%.

alice (oncall): thanks team. please add timeline entries to the postmortem doc and include the configs we changed.

carla: noted. saving diffs and links to dashboards: https://dash.redwood/inference/queues, https://dash.redwood/rl/rate_limiter

incident-bot: Incident updated: state=mitigated, severity=sev2, incident_id=2024-06-infer-37. oncall_handoff=1718000800 -> dave

dave (oncall-2): monitoring. will file follow-up for automating quota checks and safer token-bucket defaults.

alice (oncall): closing thread for live mitigation. follow-up postmortem in #postmortems. :thumbsup:
